$comment: Corrections to the vendored table.jsonschema.json (foundation-sdk v0.0.20). Sources are Grafana's CUE at the tag in `grafana`. See src/spec/overlay.ts.

patches.why: The pill, markdown and geo cell types are in the CUE since 12.4; the vendored enum rejects them.
Definition for the pill cell type.
Definition for the markdown cell type. The CUE declares it twice; the two unify to one struct with an optional dynamicHeight.
Definition for the geo cell type.
TableCellOptions is a disjunction that includes the pill variant.
TableCellOptions is a disjunction that includes the markdown variant.
TableCellOptions is a disjunction that includes the geo variant.
Grafana 13 adds the "accessible" line style; the vendored enum rejects it.

reducers.description: footer reducers to apply to this field

value.description: The footer of one field (TableFooterOptions in the CUE; renamed here because the vendored schema already has a panel-level TableFooterOptions)

patches.why: Grafana 12.4 moved the table footer onto each field; this is its shape.

value.description: options for the footer for this field

patches.why: Grafana 12.4.11 writes fieldConfig.defaults.custom.footer ({ reducers: [] }) on the table panels it exports (test/fixtures/exports/grafana-12.4.11/queries.json).

value.description: Where the cell tooltip is placed

patches.why: Placement enum of the per-field tooltip; not in the vendored schema.

field.description: The name of the field to get the tooltip content from

value.description: Tooltip shown when a cell of this field is selected or hovered

patches.why: Shape of the per-field tooltip option.

value.description: Controls whether the column can be sorted. Every column is sortable by default; set to false to disable sorting for this column.

patches.why: Grafana 13.x TableFieldOptions. The vendored schema lacks the column sorting switch.

value.description: if true, wrap the text content of the cell

patches.why: Grafana 13.x TableFieldOptions. The vendored schema lacks the cell text wrapping (k8s-views-pods uses it).

value.description: Enables text wrapping for column headers

patches.why: Grafana 13.x TableFieldOptions. The vendored schema lacks the header text wrapping.

value.description: Selecting or hovering this field will show a tooltip containing the content within the target field

patches.why: Grafana 13.x TableFieldOptions. The vendored schema lacks the per-field tooltip.

value.description: The name of the field which contains styling overrides for this cell

patches.why: Grafana 13.x TableFieldOptions. The vendored schema lacks the style override field.
